blocks.text:
Some `TreeView` examples are shown here. There are
more examples in the [treeview directory](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gtkmm-documentation/tree/&url_examples_branch;/examples/book/treeview/)
in `gtkmm-documentation`'s examples.
blocks.zh: 这里显示了一些TreeView的示例。gtkmm文档示例中的树形视图文件夹还有更多的示例。

blocks.text:
If neither `ListStore` nor `TreeStore`
is suitable for your application, look at the
[custom TreeModel](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gtkmm-documentation/tree/&url_examples_branch;/examples/book/treeview/custom_treemodel)
example. It shows how you can make your own implementation of the `TreeModel`
interface.
blocks.zh: 如果ListStore和TreeStore都不适合你的应用程序，请查看自定义树模型示例。它向你展示了如何实现自己的TreeModel接口

blocks.text:
This example has a `Gtk::TreeView` widget, with a
`Gtk::ListStore` model.
blocks.zh: 这个例子有一个使用Gtk::ListStore模型的Gtk::TreeView部件。

blocks.text:
This example is very similar to the `ListStore` example,
but uses a `Gtk::TreeStore` model instead, and adds
children to the rows.
blocks.zh: 这个示例和ListStore示例非常的相似，但是使用的是Gtk::TreeStore模型并且添加了子行。

blocks.text:
This example is identical to the `ListStore` example, but
it uses TreeView::append_column_editable() instead of
TreeView::append_column().
blocks.zh: 这个示例与ListStore示例相同，但是使用TreeView::append_column_editable()代替TreeView::append_column()。

blocks.text:
This example is much like the `TreeStore` example, but has
2 extra columns to indicate whether the row can be dragged, and whether it can
receive drag-and-dropped rows. It uses a derived
`Gtk::TreeStore` which overrides the virtual functions as
described in the [TreeView Drag and
    Drop]() section.
blocks.zh: 这个示例和TreeStore示例十分相似，但是额外有两个用于指示行是否可以进行拖放和接受拖放的列。它通过从Gtk::TreeStore来覆盖虚函数，如拖放树视图小节所述。

blocks.text:
This example is much like the `ListStore` example, but
derives a custom `TreeView` to encapsulate the tree model
code and popup menu code in our derived class. See the
[TreeView Popup Context Menu]() section.
blocks.zh: 这个例子与 `ListStore` 示例很相似，但派生了一个自定义 `TreeView`，把树模型代码与弹出菜单代码封装进派生类。参见 TreeView Popup Context Menu 一节。
